messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++14 code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<original_code>
#include <iostream>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

long long x,y,n;

long long gcd(long long a,long long b){
    return (b==0)? a:gcd(b,a % b);
}

int main(){

    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    cin >> x >> y >> n;

    if (y<=n){
        long a=gcd(x,y);
        x=x/a;y=y/a;
        cout << x << "/" << y;
        return 0;
    }
    if (x==y){
        cout << "1/1";
        return 0;
    }

    double ans=1e18;
    double xy=double(x)/double(y);
    long long ansx,ansy;
    long long l=0,r=y;
    for (long long i=1;i<=n;i++){
        while (i*x>r){l+=y;r+=y;}
        if (i*x>=l && i*x<=r) {
            long long ll=l/y;
            long long rr=r/y;
            double li=double(ll)/double(i);
            double ri=double(rr)/double(i);
            double tmp1=abs(xy-li);
            double tmp2=abs(xy-ri);
            if (tmp2<tmp1){
                if ((float)tmp2<(float)ans){
                    ans=tmp2;
                    ansx=rr;
                    ansy=i;
                }
            }else{
                if ((float)tmp1<(float)ans){
                    ans=tmp1;
                    ansx=ll;
                    ansy=i;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    long long a=gcd(ansx,ansy);
    ansx/=a;ansy/=a;
    cout << ansx << "/" << ansy;

    return 0;

}
